SingleInstanceActivationTests.Uri_argume.reason: Covers the original valid and rejected startup argument matrix. The main entry validates URI syntax before reading or creating a data directory.

tests.case: publishes only playable recent games in descending order with a ten-item limit

TaskbarJumpListControllerTests.Recent_ga.reason: Exercises the same recent-item projection contract, including uninstalled entries, missing identity, missing date, descending order and ten-item limit.

tests.case: delivers startup activations before a newer event received during the pending handshake

SingleInstanceActivationTests.Typed_requ.reason: The renderer preserves startup/event ordering and waits for setup. Production queue and native handoff checks now cover mixed FIFO ordering, coalescing and readiness. The original long.MaxValue ownership ID remains unsupported beyond JavaScript's safe integer range, so this contract is still partial.

tests.case: a second process delivers fullscreen and starts plugin installation in the same library session

SingleInstanceActivationTests.Second_pro.reason: Native activation.spec.ts additionally verifies show/fullscreen/game/plugin launches against an owner without a backend: all secondary processes exit without creating a database, and an invalid installation URI exits 2 without dispatch. Packaged executable and Windows shortcut variants still need disposable-machine validation, so this source method remains partial.
